ItemID: NA; Title: Live At The Troubadour; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar singer-songwriter music fits my recent rootsy listening; I would try this live album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Homogenic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its electronic art-pop direction is outside my current blues and roots-rock mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of the Spinners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic soul sounds appealing, but I would pass this time in favor of something closer to my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Acoustic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough about the artist or music to interest me.
ItemID: NA; Title: Star Trek Into Darkness; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for bluesy songs and performances, and this title suggests a film or soundtrack.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dust; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot identify the artist from this title, so I would skip it.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Best of The Commodores - The Millennium Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic soul and funk could suit me, but I am not interested enough to choose this compilation today.
ItemID: NA; Title: American IV: The Man Comes Around; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Johnny Cash's earthy vocals and stripped-down songs fit my current interest in roots-oriented music.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Nat King Cole; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and guitar-based music than vocal standards right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1000hp       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy hard-rock sound is more aggressive than what I want from this listening session.
